AuditFlag.description: Machine-readable red flags. A flag is a pointer for a human, never a finding.
AuditFlag.title: AuditFlag

Classification.description:
Step 1 output. Tags are ranked (most central first); every notation was validated
against the catalog pulled from the Karakutu API — the model cannot invent one.
Classification.title: Classification

notation.description: IPTC notation, e.g. medtop:20000093 or genre:Current
notation.title: Notation

GeographicScope.description:
Reach of the STORY. Mirrors the archive's `GeographicScope` minus `platform_specific`,
which describes the reach of a censorship action, not a property of an article.
GeographicScope.title: GeographicScope

RunStep.description: One durable node record, including flexible exact model and evidence I/O.
RunStep.title: RunStep

StageName.description: The six steps, in pipeline order (AuditResponse.stages is always this order).
StageName.title: StageName

Verdict.description:
Audit outcome.

None of these is a finding of censorship. `POSSIBLE_CENSORSHIP` is a triage flag that
nominates an article for human review — the determination that something *was* censored
is a human call on independent evidence, and this service has no authority to make it.
Verdict.title: Verdict

200.description: Complete run JSON attachment, including evidence and reviews.
